title: pay-policy/1
description: A vendor-neutral payment policy for an agent. Every figure is a whole number of minor units with an explicit currency code; floats are refused. The schema holds the shape; vendor-pay-policy.mjs holds what a schema cannot say: every money figure shares the policy's currency, a spending policy's humanApprovalAbove is strictly below perTransaction, and a child policy only narrows its parent.

holder.description: Who this policy binds. An opaque reference; who may hold a policy is delegation/1's question, not this format's.

parent.description: The id of the policy this one attenuates. Required by attenuate(parent, child); absent on a root policy.

currency.description: The currency every figure in this policy is denominated in.

perTransaction.description: Inclusive ceiling per payment. 0 closes the policy: it can pay nobody anything.

cap.description: Inclusive ceiling on spent-so-far plus this payment within the period.

counterparties.description: Exact-match allowlist. Empty permits no counterparty. No wildcard exists.

rails.description: Opaque lowercase rail identifiers the payment may travel on. The format names no rail.

jurisdictions.description: Two-letter uppercase codes. Absent means unrestricted; present means a payment naming none is denied.

humanApprovalAbove.description: A payment strictly above this escalates to a person. 0 escalates everything. Required whenever perTransaction is above 0.

minor.description: A whole number of minor units (2500 = 25.00 in a two-decimal currency).
